evals.prompt: 我刚上传了一张报错截图，附件路径是 ./attachments/build-error.png。请告诉我具体报错和最可能的原因。
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes the bundled vision script on the attachment, reports visible error text, and separates observed evidence from diagnosis.
expectations: The agent uses scripts/vision.js instead of guessing the screenshot contents.
The prompt sent to the vision model asks for exact visible error text.
The final answer distinguishes visible evidence from interpretation.

evals.prompt: 分析这张网络图片并用中文概括主体、可见文字和布局：https://example.com/demo.png
evals.expected_output: The agent passes the HTTP URL directly to the vision script and answers in Chinese using the returned visual evidence.
expectations: The HTTP URL is passed directly to scripts/vision.js.
The answer covers subject, visible text, and layout.
The agent does not claim success if the external image cannot be fetched.

evals.prompt: 对比附件里的 before.png 和 after.png，列出界面布局、文字和状态变化，不确定的地方要标出来。
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects both images, keeps results associated with each file, and produces an evidence-based comparison with uncertainty labels.
expectations: Both images are processed before the comparison is written.
Observations remain associated with the correct source image.
Uncertain details are explicitly labeled instead of invented.
